description: This script generates configuration and profile metadata for target hardware based on target metadata input, including features, dependencies, and versioning, primarily used in build systems.

methods.name: target_config_features
methods.description: Generates feature configuration strings based on input feature list.

methods.name: target_name
methods.description: Constructs a target name, including parent if available.

methods.name: kver
methods.description: Converts version strings to a standardized format for comparison.

methods.name: print_target
methods.description: Prints configuration blocks for a given target, including dependencies and features.

methods.name: merge_package_lists
methods.description: Merges two package lists, removing duplicates and exclusions.

methods.name: gen_target_config
methods.description: Generates a full target configuration in Kconfig format based on target metadata.

methods.name: gen_profile_mk
methods.description: Generates profile metadata in makefile format for a specified target.

methods.name: parse_command
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to invoke appropriate generation functions.
